extraFacts.fact: A logic element is a two-port poppet cartridge that opens or closes according to the force balance between its two work ports, the spring and the pilot (control) port; a balanced element switches on its control signal alone, an unbalanced element responds to the pressure at every port.

faqs.q: What is the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element used for?
faqs.a: The Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element is an unbalanced poppet logic element. High-flow check, unloading and switching functions built from one cavity and a small pilot valve. See the [logic element cartridges](/c/logic-element-cartridges).

faqs.q: Which model codes does the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element cover?
faqs.a: The Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element is built in 1 version: LOHDL: series 3, T-17A cavity, 100 gpm (380 L/min). The model code gives the series and function directly.

faqs.q: What flow and cavity does the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element have?
faqs.a: The Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element is rated 100 gpm (380 L/min) in series 3, with cavity T-17A. Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series; the series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, and a larger series carries more flow, so choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop.

faqs.q: What pressure is the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element rated for?
faqs.a: The maximum operating pressure of the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element is 5000 psi (350 bar). Pilot area ratios (pilot to port 1 / port 2): 1.8:1 / 2.25:1 Maximum leakage: 10 drops/min. (0,7 cc/min).

faqs.q: Which options and seals can I choose on the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element?
faqs.a: Check cracking pressure: D — 50 psi (3,5 bar) Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM These options apply to the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element; a size may add or drop a choice.

faqs.q: How should I read the selection notes for the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element?
faqs.a: A positive seal separates port 2 from the pilot area. Because it responds to pressure at every port, check every stage of the machine cycle against the area ratios. This applies to the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element.

faqs.q: What hex size and installation torque does the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element need?
faqs.a: The Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element has a valve hex of 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm) and an installation torque of 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm). Use a torque wrench and the right cavity, because over-torque distorts the cartridge.

faqs.q: Which seal kits fit the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element?
faqs.a: The replacement seal kits listed for the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element are series 3: Buna: 990017007, Polyurethane: 990017002, Viton: 990017006. Quote the model code and the seal material (N Buna-N, V Viton, E EPDM) when you order.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element typically used?
faqs.a: The Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element is used for: High-flow check, unloading and switching functions built from one cavity and a small pilot valve. It is the pilot-to-Close Unbalanced Poppet Logic Element in cartridge form.

faqs.q: How does the Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element compare with the Sun LODC to LOKC version?
faqs.a: The Sun LOHDL pilot-to-close unbalanced logic element differs from the [Sun LODC to LOKC pilot-to-close closed unbalanced logic element](/p/sun-hydraulics-pilot-close-closed-unbalanced-poppet-logic-element). In detail: capacity 100 gpm (380 L/min) here against 25 gpm to 300 gpm (95 L/min to 1100 L/min) on the other; series 3 here against 1 to 4 on the other. Both share the same family of cavities by frame size.

faqs.q: What is the Sun DKDC to DKJS normally closed pilot-to-open logic element used for?
faqs.a: The Sun DKDC to DKJS normally closed pilot-to-open logic element is a normally closed 2-way logic element with a balanced poppet: pressure at ports 1 and 2 does not push it open, so it switches predictably on its control signal alone. With 5,000 psi (350 bar) at both work ports. High-flow on/off switching and isolation in presses, test rigs and mobile valve blocks. See the [logic element cartridges](/c/logic-element-cartridges).

DKFC: series 2, T-2A cavity, 30 gpm (120 L/min); DKFS: series 2, T-22A cavity, 30 gpm (120 L/min); DKHC: series 3, T-17A cavity, 60 gpm (240 L/min); DKHS: series 3, T-23A cavity, 60 gpm (240 L/min); DKJC: series 4, T-19A cavity, 120 gpm (480 L/min); DKJS: series 4, T-24A cavity, 120 gpm (480 L/min). The model code gives the series and function directly.

faqs.a: The Sun DKDC to DKJS normally closed pilot-to-open logic element is rated 15 gpm to 120 gpm (60 L/min to 480 L/min) in series 1 to 4, with cavity T-11A, T-21A, T-2A, T-22A, T-17A, T-23A, T-19A, T-24A. Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series; the series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, and a larger series carries more flow, so choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop.

faqs.q: What pressure is the Sun DKDC to DKJS normally closed pilot-to-open logic element rated for?
faqs.a: The maximum operating pressure of the Sun DKDC to DKJS normally closed pilot-to-open logic element is 5000 psi (350 bar).
